description: Get one medicine from the register by slug (from search_medicines or a /lek/{slug} URL): substance, strength, form, dispensing category, marketing authorisation holder, ATC code, packs with EAN, whether it is refunded, and the sections of its patient leaflet (ulotka) and SmPC (chpl) for get_medicine_document. product_handle is set only for a non-prescription medicine sold on apteka.online (use get_product with it). apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescription products, ships only within Poland (medicines only by courier, not to parcel lockers or pickup points) and lists prices in PLN gross. Do not give medical advice. Medicine data comes from the Polish register of medicinal products (RPL) and the Ministry of Health refund announcement: prescription medicines are shown for information only and are not sold online, and refund prices are official maximum prices, not apteka.online prices.
